changsu.description: A small, high-pitched male cartoon plush character voice, clear and cute, slightly nasal. Calm, monotone, matter-of-fact reading, brisk pace, no breathiness. Korean.

misun.description: A tiny, very high-pitched female cartoon plush mascot voice with a clean, slightly synthetic text-to-speech quality. Light, even delivery with a small cheerful lift at sentence ends, fast pace. Korean.
